Package grafioschtrader.mcp.oauth

package grafioschtrader.mcp.oauth
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    grafioschtrader.mcp
     
  • Class
    Description
    ClientMetadataFetcher
    Loads the Client ID Metadata Document of an OAuth client.
    ClientMetadataService
    Identifies OAuth clients by their Client ID Metadata Document: the client_id is an HTTPS URL, and the JSON document behind it names the client and its redirect URIs.
    ClientMetadataService.ClientMetadata
    A known client.
    McpOAuthEndpoints
    Every address of the OAuth authorization of the MCP server, derived from the global parameter gt.mcp.public.base.url alone and read anew on every call, so a change by the administrator takes effect without a restart.
    OAuthAuthorizeResource
    The two server steps behind the Angular authorization page.
    OAuthAuthorizeResource.AuthorizationRequest
     
    OAuthAuthorizeResource.ConsentRequest
     
    OAuthAuthorizeResource.RedirectResponse
     
    OAuthAuthorizeResource.ValidationResponse
     
    OAuthMetadataController
    Discovery of the OAuth authorization: the protected resource metadata (RFC 9728) of the MCP endpoint and the authorization server metadata (RFC 8414).
    OAuthRequestStore
    The short-lived state of the authorization flow, held in the memory of this process: validated authorization requests waiting for the user's consent, and issued authorization codes waiting for their exchange.
    OAuthRequestStore.CodeGrant
    An issued authorization code, bound to everything the token request has to repeat.
    OAuthRequestStore.PendingRequest
    A validated authorization request.
    OAuthScopes
    Translates between the OAuth scopes of the MCP server and AccessTokenScope.
    OAuthTokenResource
    The token endpoint of the OAuth authorization (RFC 6749 with PKCE, RFC 7636, and resource indicators, RFC 8707).
    OAuthTokenService
    Issues and rotates the tokens of OAuth clients.
    OAuthTokenService.Failure
     
    OAuthTokenService.Issued
     
    OAuthTokenService.TokenResult
    The outcome of a token request: either a token pair or an OAuth error.
    OAuthValidateRateLimiter
    Bounds the anonymous validation of authorization requests to 30 per client address within an hour.
    Pkce
    Proof Key for Code Exchange (RFC 7636) with the method S256, the only one GT accepts.
